BrochureContent.Content: Henry Kee & Son are delighted to present to the market this very appealing four bedroom bungalow, set in an exceptionally scenic location right on the water's edge of Killybegs harbour. West-facing, both the kitchen and sitting room have two windows directly overlooking the harbour, allowing you to enjoy the constant movement of fishing boats, yachts etc. The regular summer visits of cruise ships docking directly across the harbour are an added attraction with the harbour lighthouse just around the corner. Internal accommodation comprises of sitting room, kitchen/dining room, utility, four bedrooms and bathroom. Featuring dual fuel central heating, recently fitted kitchen units and bathroom suite, this property is definitely in walk-in condition. Viewing guaranteed not to disappoint. All enquiries are welcome.

Entrance Hall - 5m x 1.6m + (7.4m x 1m)
PVC front door with glass side windows. Trapdoor leading to attic. Three radiators. Floor tiled.


Sitting Room - 4.7m x 4m
Two front windows overlooking the harbour. Insert stove with back boiler. Laminate timber floor.


Kitchen - 5.2m x 4m
Two front windows overlooking the harbour. High and low level kitchen units. Hotpress cupboard. Electric oven, gas hob and extractor fan - included. Franke sink.


Utility - 2.4m x 1.7m
Gable door. Plumbed for washing machine and tumbledryer - excluded. Floor tiled.


Bedroom One - 4m x 3.6m
Gable window. Floor carpeted.


Bedroom Two - 3.6m x 2.8m
Built-in wardrobe. Gable window. Floor carpeted.


Bedroom Three - 2.8m x 2.8m
Built-in wardrobe. Rear facing window. Floor carpeted.


Bedroom Four - 2.8m x 2.8m
Built-in wardrobe. Rear facing window. Floor carpeted.


Bathroom - 2.5m x 1.7m
WC and WHB. Walk-in wet-room style shower. Floor and walls fully tiled. Grosflex sheeting on ceiling. Mirror with light over WHB. Heated towel rail.
